page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 16 physical Intel Xeon 8163 cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core allocation. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-threaded performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier, with single-threaded gzip compression registering in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated vCPUs to achieve average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier scores in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached operations remains within the average range, though Passmark memory scores are relatively weak.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and average multi-threaded capability, the ecs.sn1.7xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for parallelized workloads that do not demand high single-thread performance. It is suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations. It can also handle small to medium LLM inference tasks, though text generation speeds for smaller models are weak. It is not recommended for single-threaded legacy applications or memory-intensive databases.
